revisit_triggers: a reactivation attempt produces an unexpected booking
a segment's return rate changes across cycles
the practice's product mix changes typical travel intervals

base.update_signal: reactivation outcomes or segment return rates shift across cycles, or typical travel intervals change with the product mix

nodes.definition: Understand what a client base is worth in a business with no subscription and no contracted recurring revenue, and what of it could ever pass to anyone else. The value drivers are documentation depth, demonstrated repeat and referral behaviour rather than headcount, the mix of engagement classes the margin review says actually pay, and revenue concentration - how much of the practice rides on a handful of households, which is the single most common fragility here. Portability is a contract question before it is a valuation question: the independent contractor agreement, consortium or program terms, agency-of-record conventions and any non-solicitation clause decide whether records, relationships and pending bookings can move at all, and relationships that are personal to one advisor may simply not transfer regardless of what a document says. Any price or multiple is a negotiated mechanism between a specific buyer and seller under specific terms and diligence - it is never a rule of thumb to carry, and professional advice belongs in any actual transaction. Continuity is the same question asked about an ordinary bad week: who serves clients if the advisor is unavailable, where the records live, and what clients were promised.

included: the value drivers and concentration risk of a client book
portability as governed by affiliation, program and agency-of-record terms
continuity arrangements for absence as well as exit
excluded: stating any valuation multiple, price or market comparable
the choice of affiliation model itself - agency-models KB
legal, tax or transaction advice on an actual sale

pros.claim: Naming concentration turns an invisible fragility into a managed number the advisor watches
pros.example: one extended family accounting for a large share of realized revenue, recognized as a risk rather than celebrated as a win

pros.claim: Reading the portability terms before planning an exit prevents promising a buyer something the contracts forbid
pros.example: discovering the non-solicitation and record-ownership position while there is still time to plan around it

cons.claim: Much of the value is personal to the advisor and does not survive a handover however good the records are
cons.example: clients who booked because of one advisor's judgement drifting away within a year of a transfer

cons.claim: Building book value competes with taking today's bookings, and the payoff is uncertain and distant
cons.example: hours spent structuring records and continuity arrangements in a season when selling time is scarce

failure_modes: carrying a remembered valuation multiple as though it were a market fact
planning an exit without reading the affiliation and program terms
letting a few households dominate revenue with no acquisition to balance it
having no continuity arrangement while clients are mid-trip
assuming client records are the advisor's to take
acceptance_tests: the practice records its revenue concentration as a tracked band and the contract clauses that govern record ownership, solicitation and agency of record
a named continuity arrangement exists covering absence, with records accessible to the named backup under the practice's privacy terms
no valuation figure or multiple is asserted anywhere in the practice's own planning documents without a named negotiated basis
revisit_triggers: the affiliation, consortium or program agreement is renewed or changed
one household's share of realized revenue crosses the advisor's stated comfort band
the advisor's availability, health or exit horizon changes

base.update_signal: the affiliation or program terms change, revenue concentration shifts, or the advisor's exit or availability horizon changes

edges.why_related: the terms read-out is the per-booking execution of the frame's rule that every rate lives in a document rather than in memory
the earning-versus-payment split only means something once every revenue stream has been named and mapped
fee capture executes one of the streams the revenue map identified, with its own earning event that is not travel
add-on commission is a mapped revenue stream that cannot be pursued until its obligation classes are verified
the expectation row records the base and rate source that the terms read-out produced
the row's expected pay window is derived from travel dates plus the supplier's stated payment trigger
statement lines are matched against open rows, so the row must exist and must carry the identifiers the payout path reports under
reconciliation reads the statement and applies the split understanding to classify each line
only an aged, classified row is worth escalating, and its class decides whether the host or the supplier is the right rung
the pipeline's three states and their timing come straight from the earning-versus-payment gap
fees collected are part of the realized revenue side of the hours comparison, and are the only part earned when the work is done
no offer routine may be built until the licensing, appointment and disclosure classes have been verified
the fit conversation happens inside the offer point the discipline fixes and is recorded on the same decision record
the ethical rules govern exactly the conversation the fit unit defines, from framing to disclosure to accepting a decline
what the advisor can honourably do at claim time is set by what was disclosed and promised at the sale
the return date that triggers the debrief is the same date the commission clock runs from, so both are diarized together
the debrief is where the record's preferences, supplier outcomes and future-trip signals are actually captured
the cadence is anchored on dates, patterns and consents that only exist if the record holds them
the debrief is the moment of maximum satisfaction where the specific referral ask belongs
dormancy is only measurable once a cadence has been running long enough to show who stopped responding
an honest triage is what turns a name list into the real book whose value can be discussed
a book's worth depends on the mix of engagement classes that actually pay, not on how many households it lists
the verified class draws the line between describing categories and advising on coverage, which is the whole shape of the fit conversation
edges.risk_of_conflict: an advisor who has not verified the class improvises an opinion on coverage

edges.why_related: the same obligation class bounds claim-time help to custody of documents and facilitation rather than adjudication or representation
edges.risk_of_conflict: sympathy at claim time pulls the advisor into arguing coverage with an adjuster

edges.why_related: the disclosure, no-pressure and no-traded-endorsement rules bind referral asks and any incentive exactly as they bind add-on offers
edges.risk_of_conflict: an undisclosed referral reward quietly buys an endorsement the client does not actually hold

edges.why_related: consent, opt-out and vulnerable-client care limit how often and how insistently the cadence may reach a client
edges.risk_of_conflict: a thin pipeline turns a useful cadence into pressure on clients who asked for less contact

edges.why_related: reversal exposure sets the floor under the reserve and decides which receipts may be treated as spendable
edges.risk_of_conflict: a thin month tempts the advisor to draw against provisional commission

edges.why_related: hours spent recovering small balances are the same hours the margin review says belong to work that pays
edges.resolution_rule: escalate where the amount, the supplier's pattern or the precedent justifies it; below the practice's own stated threshold band, file the write-off with its reason as supplier-performance evidence and return the hours to client work
edges.risk_of_conflict: an advisor spends a week recovering amounts that a single engagement would have out-earned

edges.why_related: offering to everyone every time collides with accepting a decline and never pressuring a client who has already said no
edges.resolution_rule: offer once at the fixed point and record the decision; re-raise only when a materially changed trip fact appears, such as a new nonrefundable payment or a changed party, and never with fear framing - the ethical rule wins whenever the two disagree
edges.risk_of_conflict: a universal-offer routine becomes repeated pressure on a client who has declined twice

edges.why_related: add-on commission is one of the few revenue lines that pays quickly, so a thin cash month creates pressure to sell coverage a client does not need
edges.resolution_rule: fit decides the recommendation and compensation is disclosed either way; cash need never enters the conversation, and a thin month is fixed through fee capture, pipeline timing and declining underwater work rather than through the client's coverage decision
edges.risk_of_conflict: an advisor upsells a broader plan class because the month has been quiet

edges.why_related: a fee at the door filters out the casual enquirers who make up a large share of referral traffic
edges.resolution_rule: keep the fee and move the disclosure upstream: the forwardable referral introduction states plainly that planning is engaged under written terms, so referred prospects self-select before the first call instead of being surprised at it
edges.risk_of_conflict: referrers stop introducing people because they expect the fee conversation to embarrass them

edges.why_related: how the advisor behaves when something goes wrong is the strongest determinant of whether that client ever refers anyone
misreading the base or missing a void condition is what turns an ordinary change into a shortfall or a recall months later
when rebooking conversations happen decides when travel happens, and therefore when commission is payable at all
the debrief closes the trip and starts the anniversary clock that the next contact is timed against
reversals and offsets are posted against their rows in the same close, before ageing and escalation decisions are made
what actually gets recovered, and from whom, teaches the practice how to read that supplier's terms and whether to keep selling it
realized-revenue evidence shows which scope items must be inside the engagement terms and where fee capture is failing to cover the work
both are ageing-and-triage disciplines over a decaying queue where the skill is deciding what to pursue, what to park and what to close with a recorded reason

conflict_axes.name: addon_revenue_versus_honest_fit
conflict_axes.description: Protection add-ons pay the advisor and pay sooner than trip commission, which puts revenue pressure directly against the client's actual need for the product.
poles: maximize add-on attachment
recommend only on demonstrated trip exposure
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fit decides and compensation is disclosed regardless of the answer; cash pressure is resolved through fee capture and pipeline timing, never through the client's coverage decision

conflict_axes.name: booked_optimism_versus_traveled_reality
conflict_axes.description: Booking volume feels like income and arrives months before the money, so every reporting and spending decision can be made on the flattering number or the real one.
poles: report and plan on booked volume
report and plan on traveled and received revenue
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep the two lines separate and non-additive; spend and draw only against received, non-reversible revenue while using booked volume solely as a dated pipeline

conflict_axes.name: chase_persistence_versus_supplier_relationship
conflict_axes.description: The persistence that recovers commission is applied to the same suppliers and contacts whose goodwill the advisor needs for client outcomes next season.
poles: escalate every shortfall to the top
protect the relationship and absorb small losses
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: escalate documented facts rather than grievances, keep the ladder bounded by the supplier's own stated claim window, and let repeated shortfalls change supplier selection rather than escalate tone

conflict_axes.name: fee_certainty_versus_enquiry_volume
conflict_axes.description: A planning fee collected before work guarantees payment for the advisor's time but reduces the number of casual and referred enquiries who reach a first conversation.
poles: collect the fee before any design work
stay open to unqualified enquiries
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the fee and move the disclosure upstream into the referral and enquiry material so prospects self-select before the call rather than being surprised during it

conflict_axes.name: universal_offer_versus_no_pressure
conflict_axes.description: Offering protection to every client without exception protects clients from being skipped, but repeating the offer to someone who has declined becomes pressure.
poles: offer to everyone, every time
accept the decline and stop
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: one recorded offer at the fixed point, one recorded decision, and a re-raise only on a materially changed trip fact - never on a slow month or a persuasion instinct

conflict_axes.name: record_richness_versus_data_minimization
conflict_axes.description: The detail that makes repeat service excellent is also sensitive personal data the practice must protect, justify holding and eventually delete.
poles: capture everything that could help
hold only what the service demonstrably needs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold detail that serves the client's own trips under stated consent and retention positions, keep no payment card data, and prune on the same cycle the cadence runs on

conflict_axes.name: cadence_presence_versus_inbox_fatigue
conflict_axes.description: Staying present across long gaps between trips requires contact, and contact that is not useful to that specific client destroys the relationship it was meant to preserve.
poles: contact often to stay top of mind
contact rarely and only with something useful
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: anchor every touch on the client's own dates and recorded pattern, require a usefulness test before sending, and treat any opt-out as immediate and permanent

conflict_axes.name: concentrated_high_value_versus_diversified_book
conflict_axes.description: A few households who travel richly are the most profitable clients a small practice can have and the largest single-point failure it can carry.
poles: serve the few who pay best
spread revenue across many households
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: serve the high-value households properly while tracking concentration as a watched band and deliberately funding acquisition and reactivation out of the strong months

conflict_axes.name: claim_time_warmth_versus_role_boundary
conflict_axes.description: The client in a claim wants an advocate who will tell them they are covered, and the one thing the advisor must not do is answer that question.
poles: advocate for the client's coverage
stay a document custodian and facilitator
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: be maximally fast and generous with documents, timelines and access while stating plainly that the insurer decides, and route interpretation to the insurer or a licensed professional

conflict_axes.name: close_speed_versus_evidence_completeness
conflict_axes.description: A fast monthly close keeps the practice selling, but rows closed without evidence are exactly the ones that turn out to be unpaid after the claim window has shut.
poles: close fast on best-available matching
hold rows open until evidence agrees
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: match on identifiers rather than amounts, allow a not-yet-due status so speed does not force false closure, and set every row's escalation date from the supplier's stated window at the moment the row is opened

edge_cases.description: A client pays the planning fee, receives the designed itinerary, then books it themselves online because they found a promotion
edge_cases.trigger: a fee-paying client books direct after the design work is delivered
edge_cases.mitigation: the engagement terms already state that the fee pays for advisory work regardless of where the booking lands; keep the fee, log the engagement as fee-only in the realized-revenue review, and decide deliberately whether this client is invited back

edge_cases.description: A large multi-cabin family booking cancels after the supplier has already paid commission, and the recovery appears as an offset on a later statement
edge_cases.trigger: a paid booking is cancelled or refunded and the supplier recalls the commission
edge_cases.mitigation: pre-travel receipts were flagged provisional and never drawn against, the row stayed open until the reversal window passed, and the offset is matched back to the booking rather than treated as unexplained shrinkage

edge_cases.description: Commission arrives as a single lump line on a host statement with no booking reference the advisor recognizes
edge_cases.trigger: a payout cannot be matched to any open expectation row
edge_cases.mitigation: match on traveller name, supplier and travel dates rather than amount, query the host with the row's identifiers, and record the identifier convention so the same supplier matches automatically next time

edge_cases.description: A supplier's stated claim window closes before the advisor notices that a completed trip was never paid
edge_cases.trigger: an open row ages past its expected pay window unseen during a peak season
edge_cases.mitigation: give every row an escalation date derived from the supplier's own stated window at the moment it is opened, and run the close on schedule even in peak season; file the claim incomplete rather than late, since evidence can be supplemented but a closed window cannot be reopened

edge_cases.description: A client asks directly whether their mother's heart condition will be covered if she cannot travel
edge_cases.trigger: a client requests a coverage opinion on a specific medical situation
edge_cases.mitigation: describe generically that plans commonly define look-back and purchase-timing mechanics, hand over the plan documents, direct the question to the insurer or a licensed producer, and record that the referral was made; give no opinion and no reassurance

edge_cases.description: A recently bereaved elderly client is being walked through a complex protection upgrade by phone while a relative presses for a decision
edge_cases.trigger: a vulnerable client faces an add-on decision under time and family pressure
edge_cases.mitigation: slow the process, send the material in writing, invite a support person the client chooses, confirm understanding rather than agreement, and accept a not-now answer without a second ask

edge_cases.description: A client cancels their protection plan inside the review window after seeing the premium on their statement
edge_cases.trigger: a free-look cancellation reverses the add-on commission
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the add-on row provisional until the review window closes, expect the reversal, and use the conversation to re-check whether the trip's exposure was actually understood rather than to resell

edge_cases.description: A claim is denied and the client tells the advisor they were promised it would be covered
edge_cases.trigger: a denied claim collides with the client's recollection of the sale
edge_cases.mitigation: produce the dated offer-and-decision record and the at-sale statement that the insurer decides, help assemble documents for the insurer's own appeal channel, and never argue the coverage question; if no record exists, treat it as a process failure and fix the routine

edge_cases.description: A reliable client who travels every second year goes quiet for fourteen months after an excellent trip
edge_cases.trigger: silence that a fixed dormancy rule would misread as a lost client
edge_cases.mitigation: judge dormancy against that household's own recorded interval, make one useful and specific contact timed to their historic planning month, and only then reclassify

edge_cases.description: One extended family accounts for a large share of the practice's realized revenue across several bookings a year
edge_cases.trigger: revenue concentration in a single household group
edge_cases.mitigation: track the share as a watched band, serve them properly without reorganizing the practice around them, and fund reactivation and acquisition deliberately out of the months they pay

edge_cases.description: The advisor is hospitalized with clients mid-planning and one party already in transit
edge_cases.trigger: sudden advisor unavailability with live bookings and active travel
edge_cases.mitigation: a named continuity arrangement agreed in advance, records held in the practice's own system and accessible to that person under the practice's privacy terms and the affiliation agreement, and clients told who is covering rather than left messaging into silence

edge_cases.description: A referred prospect arrives expecting free advice because the referrer described the service without mentioning engagement terms
edge_cases.trigger: a referral handoff that omits how the practice works
edge_cases.mitigation: use a forwardable introduction that states who the practice serves and that planning is engaged under written terms, so the fee is known before the first call rather than discovered in it

workflow.action: Map the practice's revenue streams and their earning and payment events
workflow.description: List commission, fees, add-on commission and bonus programs with the document that defines each and the events that earn and pay it
workflow.gate: every stream names its defining document, earning event, payment event and payer, with no remembered rate stated as fact

workflow.action: Verify the protection obligation classes before any add-on is offered
workflow.description: Confirm licensing, appointment, disclosure and record-keeping classes with the regulator, insurer and host, and record the confirmations and dates
workflow.artifact: verified requirement-class record with confirmation dates
workflow.gate: each applicable class is written down with the body that confirmed it and the date, or the fallback referral path is documented and no offer is made

workflow.action: Read the commissionable base and void conditions for the supplier and product in hand
workflow.description: Locate the base in the supplier's own agency terms, note rate type and agency-of-record conditions, and record the source
workflow.artifact: per-booking terms read-out attached to the booking file
workflow.gate: the base, its source document and at least one void condition are recorded before the booking is treated as revenue

workflow.action: Issue engagement terms and collect the planning fee before design work starts
workflow.description: Send written scope, inclusions, revision limits and the refund or credit position, collect the fee and issue a receipt
workflow.artifact: signed engagement terms and fee receipt
workflow.gate: no design work has begun without signed terms and a cleared fee, or a recorded deliberate exception

workflow.action: Open the commission expectation row at the moment of booking
workflow.description: Record payer, supplier, confirmation number, agency identifier, travel dates, base, rate source, expected gross, payout path and expected pay window, and attach the evidence pack
workflow.artifact: open expectation row with attached confirmation and invoice
workflow.gate: the row can be reconstructed and claimed on by someone with no memory of the trip

workflow.action: Offer protection at the fixed point and record the client's decision
workflow.description: Offer to every client at or before deposit, describe the product family, provide the materials and log the dated decision in the client's own words
workflow.artifact: dated offer-and-decision record on the booking file
workflow.gate: no booking file lacks an offer record, and declines are logged once rather than re-raised

workflow.action: Run the exposure and fit conversation inside the describe-and-refer line
workflow.description: Map this trip's nonrefundable exposure, penalty dates, remoteness and party linkage, hand over the plan documents, and refer interpretation questions to the insurer or a licensed producer
workflow.artifact: recorded exposure summary and the documents and contacts given to the client
workflow.gate: no advisor-authored coverage summary or opinion appears on file, and the client can state what they carry if they decline

workflow.action: Reconcile statements and age every open row on a fixed close
workflow.description: Match payments on identifiers, classify each variance, post reversals against their rows, and give every open row a status
workflow.artifact: closed reconciliation period with a statused row register
workflow.gate: no row is left unstatused and none is marked matched on amount alone

workflow.action: Escalate aged rows before the supplier's stated claim window closes
workflow.description: Send the reusable evidence pack up the ladder from host support to supplier commission desk to relationship contact, recording each rung
workflow.artifact: claim log with dated escalations and outcomes
workflow.gate: every aged row is escalated within its window or closed with a logged write-off reason attributed to a supplier

workflow.action: Refresh the pipeline and the spendable figure
workflow.description: Update booked, travelled-not-paid and received states, exclude provisional lines, and check the reserve intention against current reversal exposure
workflow.gate: the spendable figure counts only received, non-reversible revenue and the reserve intention is stated against the practice's own exposure

workflow.action: Run the welcome-home debrief and capture what it produces
workflow.description: Hold the structured conversation, feed supplier failures back, update preferences, and make the specific review and referral asks
workflow.artifact: debrief notes written into the client record with referral and review outcomes
workflow.gate: every completed trip has a dated debrief whose notes reached the client record rather than an inbox

workflow.action: Review realized revenue, book concentration and continuity on a periodic cycle
workflow.description: Rank engagement classes on hours against received revenue, restate concentration, re-read the portability clauses, and confirm the continuity arrangement
workflow.artifact: periodic practice review covering margin ranking, concentration band and continuity plan
workflow.gate: concentration is stated as a tracked band, the governing clauses are cited rather than assumed, and no valuation multiple is asserted without a named negotiated basis

dominance_rules.rule: Verified requirement class dominates any add-on revenue opportunity
dominance_rules.rationale: offering an insurance product outside the applicable licensing or appointment class exposes the practice to consequences no commission can offset, and the classes differ by jurisdiction and change
dominance_rules.trigger: an advisor is about to present, recommend or solicit a travel-protection product
dominance_rules.action: stop until the applicable class is confirmed with the regulator, insurer and host; if it cannot be confirmed, book the travel only and refer the client to a licensed source

dominance_rules.rule: Client fit dominates advisor compensation on every recommendation
dominance_rules.rationale: a recommendation shaped by what pays best destroys the trust that is the entire asset of a referral-driven practice
dominance_rules.trigger: the better-paying option is not the better-fitting option for this client and trip
dominance_rules.action: recommend the fit, disclose the compensation relationship either way, and record what was recommended and why

dominance_rules.rationale: a client who learns after the fact that the advisor was paid treats every earlier recommendation as suspect
dominance_rules.trigger: any recommendation where the advisor is paid by a supplier or insurer, or a preferred-program relationship exists
dominance_rules.action: state the relationship in the client's channel of record before the decision, not in fine print afterwards

dominance_rules.rule: A dated record dominates anyone's recollection
dominance_rules.rationale: disputes about offers, declines and promises surface months later when memory on both sides has reshaped itself
dominance_rules.trigger: a client says they were never offered protection, never warned about a penalty date, or were promised an outcome
dominance_rules.action: produce the dated record; where none exists, treat it as a process failure to be fixed rather than a client to be argued with

dominance_rules.rule: Traveled-and-received dominates booked when reporting income or spending money
dominance_rules.rationale: commission is reversible until travel completes and the payment lands, so booked volume is a forecast rather than income
dominance_rules.trigger: a strong booking month tempts a spending, hiring or drawing decision
dominance_rules.action: report and spend against received, non-reversible revenue and keep booked volume as a dated pipeline line

dominance_rules.rule: The supplier's stated claim window dominates the advisor's convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: an incomplete claim can be supplemented, but a window that has closed cannot be reopened
dominance_rules.trigger: an open row ages toward the escalation date set from that supplier's stated window
dominance_rules.action: file within the window even if the evidence pack is imperfect, then complete it

dominance_rules.rule: The client's own travel rhythm dominates a generic contact calendar
dominance_rules.rationale: households in this vertical travel on intervals that differ by years, so a fixed calendar both pesters and abandons the wrong people
dominance_rules.trigger: any cadence, dormancy or reactivation decision
dominance_rules.action: measure against that household's recorded interval and planning month rather than a uniform rule

dominance_rules.rule: Consent and opt-out dominate cadence and reactivation ambitions
dominance_rules.rationale: contact permission is the client's to give and withdraw, and ignoring it costs the relationship permanently as well as breaching the practice's stated terms
dominance_rules.trigger: a client asks for less contact, does not respond across a full cycle, or opts out
dominance_rules.action: reduce or stop immediately, record the preference, and keep only the data the practice can still justify holding

dominance_rules.rule: Vulnerable-client care dominates closing the sale
dominance_rules.rationale: a decision extracted from someone who was overwhelmed is worthless commercially and indefensible otherwise
dominance_rules.trigger: signals of bereavement, illness, cognitive load, third-party pressure or a language barrier around a purchase decision
dominance_rules.action: slow the process, put it in writing, invite a support person the client chooses, confirm understanding, and accept a decline without a second ask

dominance_rules.rule: Contract terms dominate any assumed book value or portability
dominance_rules.rationale: record ownership, non-solicitation and agency-of-record conventions decide what can move, regardless of what the advisor believes they built
dominance_rules.trigger: planning a sale, transfer, merger or exit involving the client base
dominance_rules.action: read the affiliation, consortium and program clauses first and take professional advice before promising anyone anything

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the protection obligation classes before designing any offer routine or client-facing material
anti_rework_rules.prevents: building a revenue line, a script and a client expectation that must all be withdrawn once the licensing or appointment position turns out to be different

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the commissionable base and void conditions before recording any expected commission
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a pipeline populated with revenue that was never payable and a forecast that has to be rebuilt row by row

anti_rework_rules.rule: Open the expectation row at booking rather than when the payment is expected
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing months-old bookings from memory and client files when a statement arrives short

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set each row's escalation date from the supplier's own stated claim window at the moment the row is opened
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering during a year-end cleanup that the windows on several unpaid rows have already closed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Collect the planning fee and issue written scope before design work begins
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unpaid design work and a fee conversation held after the client already has the itinerary in hand

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the protection offer and the client's decision at the moment it happens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unwinnable dispute months later about what was offered and what was said

anti_rework_rules.rule: Treat commission received before travel completes as provisional until the reversal window has passed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: drawing or spending money that an offset later removes, and the emergency that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture preferences, supplier outcomes and the referral ask inside the welcome-home window
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-interviewing a returning client from scratch and losing the referral to fading enthusiasm

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask for contact consent and record preferences before building any cadence calendar
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding the calendar and apologizing after complaints and opt-outs have already cost relationships

anti_rework_rules.rule: Keep client knowledge in the practice's own structured record as the work happens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing the book out of inboxes and phone threads at continuity, transfer or exit time, when it is worth least

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same supplier short-pays or misses payment across consecutive closes
iteration_protocol.action: re-read that supplier's agency terms, tighten the fields recorded for its bookings, and reweigh whether it stays in rotation

iteration_protocol.trigger: the host restates its split, plan structure, statement format or payout schedule
iteration_protocol.action: re-map the payout path, re-time the pipeline windows, and re-run the last close against the new format

iteration_protocol.trigger: a licensing, appointment or registration renewal falls due, or the practice starts serving clients in another jurisdiction
iteration_protocol.action: pause offering, re-verify the obligation classes with the regulator, insurer and host, and update what may be said before resuming

iteration_protocol.trigger: a claim is denied or a client complains about how coverage or compensation was presented
iteration_protocol.action: review the offer record and the at-sale language, correct the routine, and re-brief on the describe-and-refer line

iteration_protocol.trigger: the practice's spendable revenue or reserve falls below its stated floor for the season
iteration_protocol.action: re-time the pipeline, tighten fee capture, hold discretionary spending, and re-check reversal exposure before any drawing decision

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeat bookings or referrals from a trip type or segment fall away across a cycle
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine the debrief content and the cadence timing for that segment and change the anchor or the ask

iteration_protocol.trigger: an engagement class lands below the practice's own working band on hours against received revenue
iteration_protocol.action: change the scope, move the work inside the fee, or stop accepting that class and redirect those enquiries honestly

iteration_protocol.trigger: one household's share of realized revenue crosses the advisor's stated comfort band, or the advisor's availability changes
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the concentration band, re-read the portability clauses and confirm or rebuild the continuity arrangement

priority_rationale: The revenue map, the payment-timing reality and the protection requirement classes come first because every later act - what is recorded, what is offered, what may be said, what may be spent - is constrained by them; commission terms, expectation rows, payout-path reading, reconciliation, chase and clawback follow in the order money actually moves, since none of them can be repaired retroactively once a claim window or a reversal has passed; fee capture and the realized-revenue review sit alongside them because they are the only levers on the gap; the protection offer, fit conversation, ethical rules and claim-time role are sequenced so that nothing is offered before it is permitted and nothing is promised that the insurer must later decide; and the post-trip debrief, client record, cadence, referral engine, dormancy triage and book-value review come last because they compose everything above into the repeat-and-referral engine that gives a low-frequency practice its recurrence.
